{{Short description|Algebraic geometric theorem}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Enriques–Babbage theorem''' states that a [[canonical curve]] is either a set-theoretic intersection of quadrics, or trigonal, or a plane quintic.  It was proved by {{harvs|txt|last=Babbage|year=1939}} and {{harvs|txt|last=Enriques|year=1919}}.
